reason: Hours-blind Sage parity: R1 125.00 (Sage's flat 25% for its 'Temporary/Part time' status) against engine R0.00 with HOURS_NOT_RECORDED. The case carries no hours, so G21 Rev 1 p. 27-28 cannot put it in non-standard employment; the statutory 22 h and under-5 h cases are ts-standard-22h-boundary-tables-not-flat-25pct and ts-non-standard-under-5h-day-flat-25pct.
closedBy: Never by a status label: only if Sage's hours for this employee are recorded (then correct the fixture or add them). Parity only.

reason: An IRP3(b) fixed-percentage directive must be applied as its percentage (G21 Rev 1 p. 15, 17). The calculator only takes a lump-sum directive's PAYE, so it applies the tables: R4 681.00 against R6 000.00.

As fixed-rate-directive-20pct, with a retirement annuity: the directive percentage applies before allowable deductions (G21 Rev 1 p. 15), so PAYE is 20% of R30 000 = R6 000.00; the calculator takes the RA off and applies the tables: R3 901.00.

The employer retirement contribution (15% of RFI = R3 000) is ignored (EMPLOYER_CONTRIBUTION_NOT_SUPPORTED), so the employee R4 000 is allowed in full. As a taxable fringe benefit deemed paid by the employee it joins the s11F pool: 27.5% x 23 000 = 6 325 binds on the R7 000 total. Expected 1 516.50.
An IRP3(c) fixed-amount directive (G21 p. 16-17) is not applied: the calculator uses the tables (R4 681.00) instead of the directed R2 500.00, and net pay follows.
